name: Marked
objective: An injured Pokémon bears a strange red marking. The researcher says it isn't natural. Follow the tracks into the forest.
intro: The tracks lead deep into the pines. Someone has been here recently — and recently enough that they are still watching.
dialogue: Researcher: "That marking isn't natural. Something — or someone — did that to it."
Krampus Scout: "Those tracks? You saw nothing."
